note: Rush Hour Chapter 3, the spice stall (GAME_CONTENT_PLAN §3), 22 Oct 2026. The game plays these as Sketch cards until each is approved and imported with scripts/import-game-art.py. Fictional labels only, never real brands.

assets.subject: a countertop blender for a cooking game station
assets.details: A sturdy cream-coloured blender base with a tall clear jug and a coral lid, about two-thirds of the image tall. Empty jug, front three-quarter view, soft rounded shapes.

assets.subject: sambal tempeh in a small bowl
assets.details: Crisp golden tempeh cubes glossy with deep red chilli sambal, a few curry leaves on top. No meat, no seafood, no egg.

assets.subject: coconut chutney in a small steel bowl
assets.details: Thick pale white coconut chutney flecked with green chilli, a spoonful of tempered mustard seeds and curry leaves on top. No dairy.

assets.subject: mint chutney in a small bowl
assets.details: Bright green smooth mint and coriander chutney with a lime wedge beside it.

assets.subject: vegetarian green curry in a bowl
assets.details: Pale green coconut curry with eggplant pieces, tofu cubes and Thai basil leaves. No meat, no seafood, no egg.

assets.subject: three long stalks of fresh lemongrass lying flat
assets.details: Long, stiff, woody pale yellow-green stalks, as thick as a finger and the same width from end to end, with a slightly swollen pale base cut flat (no roots) and dry, fibrous grass-like tops cut off square. Never a bulb, never hollow green leaves, never tied in a bundle: it must not look like spring onion or leek.

assets.subject: a knob of fresh galangal root
assets.details: Cream skin with faint pink rings, firmer and paler than ginger.

assets.subject: two fresh green chillies
assets.details: Long glossy bright green chillies with short stems.

assets.subject: a sprig of kaffir lime leaves
assets.details: Glossy dark green double leaves on a small stem.

assets.subject: a bunch of Thai basil
assets.details: Green leaves with purple stems and a small purple flower spike.

assets.subject: a long purple eggplant
assets.details: Slim glossy purple eggplant with a green cap.

assets.subject: a bunch of fresh mint
assets.details: Bright green crinkled mint leaves on stems.

assets.subject: two small limes, one cut in half
assets.details: Bright green limes; the cut half shows pale green flesh.

assets.subject: freshly grated coconut in half a coconut shell
assets.details: Fluffy snowy white coconut shreds heaped in a half coconut shell with a hairy brown outside, a small curved piece of white coconut flesh beside it. No wooden bowl: it must not look like a bowl of rice.

assets.subject: a small tub of plain yoghurt
assets.details: White tub with a simple label reading 'Plain yoghurt'.

assets.subject: a small pile of shelled candlenuts
assets.details: Five round, smooth, waxy cream-yellow nuts, some broken in half to show a solid oily inside, like macadamia nuts. No points, no papery skin, no cloves, no root ends: they must not look like garlic or shallots.

assets.subject: a block of tamarind pulp
assets.details: Dark brown sticky tamarind block in clear wrap with a small label reading 'Tamarind'.

assets.subject: a glass jar of laksa paste
assets.details: Jar of orange-red spice paste with a plain label reading 'Laksa paste'. The two look-alike jars share this picture; only the label text in the game tells them apart.

assets.subject: a small tub of green curry paste
assets.details: Tub of thick green paste with a plain label reading 'Green curry paste'. Both look-alike tubs share this picture.
